questions.stem:
Identify the correct statements.
A. Arginine and Tryptophan are essential amino acids.
B. Histidine does not contain heterocyclic ring in its structure.
C. Proline is a six membered cyclic ring amino acid.
D. Glycine does not have chiral centre.
E. Cysteine has characteristic feature of side chain as $\mathrm{MeS - CH_2 - CH_2 -}$.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
(A) Arginine and Tryptophan are essential amino acids.
(B) Histidine has heterocyclic ring in its structure.
(C) proline is a 5 numbered cyclic ring amino acid.
(D) $\mathrm{NH_2{-}CH_2{-}COOH}$ glycine does not have chiral centre.
(E) $\mathrm{HS{-}CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ is structure of cysteine.

questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.stem:
Identify correct statements from the following :
A. Propanal and propanone are functional isomers.
B. Ethoxyethane and methoxypropane are metamers.
C. But-2-ene shows optical isomerism.
D. But-1-ene and but-2-ene are functional isomers.
E. Pentane and 2, 2-dimethyl propane are chain isomers.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
(A) $\mathrm{CH_3{-}CH_2{-}CHO}$ (Propanal) and $\mathrm{CH_3{-}CO{-}CH_3}$ (Propanone) are functional isomers.
(B) Ethoxyethane and Methoxypropane are metamers.
(C) $\mathrm{CH_3{-}CH{=}CH{-}CH_3}$ does not show optical isomerism.
(D) But–1–ene and But–2–ene are position isomers.
(E) Pentane and 2,2–dimethyl propane are chain isomers.

questions.stem: 80 mL of a hydrocarbon on mixing with 264 mL of oxygen in a closed U-tube undergoes complete combustion. The residual gases after cooling to 273 K occupy 224 mL. When the system is treated with KOH solution, the volume decreases to 64 mL. The formula of the hydrocarbon is :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{C_xH_y(g)} + \left(x + \frac{y}{4}\right)\mathrm{O_2(g)} \longrightarrow x\mathrm{CO_2(g)} + \frac{y}{2}\mathrm{H_2O}(\ell)$
80    264
$264 - 80\left(x + \frac{y}{4}\right)$;\ \ $80x$
$264 - 80\left(x + \frac{y}{4}\right) + 80x = 224$
$40 = 80 \times \frac{y}{4}$
$y = 2$
$224 - 80x = 64$
$x = 2$

questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I: When an electric discharge is passed through gaseous hydrogen, the hydrogen molecules dissociate and the energetically excited hydrogen atoms produce electromagnetic radiation of discrete frequencies.
Statement II: The frequency of second line of Balmer series obtained from $\mathrm{He^{+}}$ is equal to that of first line of Lyman series obtained from hydrogen atom.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
In presence of energy $\mathrm{H_2}$ molecules dissociate and excited $e^{-}$s deexcite to produce electromagnetic radiation of discrete frequencies.
Statement I is true.
For $\mathrm{He^{+1}}$ second line of Balmer series
$\frac{1}{\lambda} = R\left(\frac{1}{2^{2}} - \frac{1}{4^{2}}\right)2^{2}$
$= R\left(1 - \frac{1}{4}\right)$
$\lambda = \frac{4}{3R}$
For H first line of Lymann series
$\frac{1}{\lambda} = R\left(\frac{1}{1^{2}} - \frac{1}{2^{2}}\right)$
$\lambda = \frac{4}{3R}$
Both $\lambda$ are equal so frequency is also equal.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false

questions.stem:
For the reaction, $\mathrm{N_2O_4 \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2}$, graph is plotted as shown below. Identify correct statements.
A. Standard free energy change for the reaction is $-5.40\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
B. As $\Delta G^\circ$ in graph is positive, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ will not dissociate into $\mathrm{NO_2}$ at all.
C. Reverse reaction will go to completion.
D. When 1 mole of $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ changes into equilibrium mixture, value of $\Delta G^\circ = -0.84\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
E. When 2 mole of $\mathrm{NO_2}$ changes into equilibrium mixture, $\Delta G^\circ$ for equilibrium mixture is $-6.24\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{N_2O_4 \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2}$
(A) $\Delta G^\circ = \Sigma G^\circ_{(P)} - \Delta G^\circ_{(R)}$
$= G_B - G_A = +\mathrm{ve}$
(B) as $\Delta G^\circ$ is +ve so $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ will dissociate into $\mathrm{NO_2}$ partially.
(C) Since forward reaction happen partially so backward reaction will not happen completely.
(D) When 1 mole of $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ changes into equilibrium mixture change of G is 0.84 w.r.t. initial.
$\Delta G^\circ = -0.84\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
(E) When 2 mole of $\mathrm{NO_2}$ changes into equilibrium mixture change of G is $(5.4 + 0.84)$ w.r.t. initial.
$\Delta G^\circ = -(0.84 + 5.4)$
$= -6.24\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$

questions.stem: Pre-exponential factors of two different reactions of same order are identical. Let activation energy of first reaction exceeds the activation energy of second reaction by $20\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$. If $k_1$ and $k_2$ are the rate constants of first and second reaction respectively at 300 K, then $\ln\frac{k_2}{k_1}$ will be ________. (nearest integer) $[R = 8.3\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}]$
questions.solution:
For reaction (1) A = A of reaction (2)
$E_{a_1} - E_{a_2} = 20\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
$\frac{K_2}{K_1} = \frac{Ae^{-\frac{E_{a_2}}{RT}}}{Ae^{-\frac{E_{a_1}}{RT}}}$
$\frac{K_2}{K_1} = e^{\frac{E_{a_1} - E_{a_2}}{RT}}$
$\frac{K_2}{K_1} = e^{\frac{20 \times 10^{3}}{R \times 300}}$
$\ln\frac{K_2}{K_1} = \frac{20 \times 10^{3}}{8.3 \times 300}$
$= 8.03$

questions.stem:
Use the following data :
Substance | $\Delta_f H^{\ominus}(500\ \mathrm{K})/\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ | $S^{\ominus}(500\ \mathrm{K})/\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$
$\mathrm{AB(g)}$ | 32 | 222
$\mathrm{A_2(g)}$ | 6 | 146
$\mathrm{B_2(g)}$ | $x$ | 280
One mole each of $\mathrm{A_2(g)}$ and $\mathrm{B_2(g)}$ are taken in a 1 L closed flask and allowed to establish the equilibrium at 500 K.
$\mathrm{A_2(g) + B_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2AB(g)}$
The value of $x$ (in $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$) is _______. (Nearest integer)
(Given : $\log K = 2.2$, $R = 8.3\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$)
questions.solution:
$\log K = 2.2$
$\Delta H^\circ = \Sigma \Delta H_{f(P)} - \Sigma \Delta H_{f(R)}$
$= [2(32) - (6 + x)] \times 10^{3}\ \mathrm{J}$
$\Delta S^\circ = \Sigma S_{(P)} - \Sigma S_{(R)}$
$= 2 \times 222 - (146 + 180)$
$= 18$
$\Delta G^\circ = -RT\ln K$
$= -8.3 \times 500 \times 2.303 \times \log K$
$= -21026.4\ \mathrm{J}$
$\Delta G^\circ = -21.02\ \mathrm{kJ}$
$\Delta G^\circ = \Delta H^\circ - T\Delta S^\circ$
$-21.02 = (58 - x) - 500\left(\frac{18}{1000}\right)$
$-21.02 = 58 - x - 9$
$-12.02 = 58 - x$
$x = 70.02\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$

questions.stem:
The pH and conductance of a weak acid (HX) was found to be 5 and $4 \times 10^{-5}\ \mathrm{S}$, respectively. The conductance was measured under standard condition using a cell where the electrode plates having a surface area of $1\ \mathrm{cm^{2}}$ were at a distance of 15 cm apart. The value of the limiting molar conductivity is _________ $\mathrm{S\,m^{2}\,mol^{-1}}$. (nearest integer)
(Given : degree of dissociation of the weak acid $(\alpha) \ll 1$)
questions.solution:
pH = 5; $\mathrm{HX \rightleftharpoons H^{+} + X^{-}}$
$[\mathrm{H^{+}}] = 10^{-5} = c\alpha$; C | $C - C\alpha$ | $C\alpha$ | $C\alpha$
$10^{-5} = c\frac{\lambda_m}{\lambda_m^{\infty}}$ ...(1)
$K = G.G^{*}$
$= 4 \times 10^{-5} \times \frac{15}{1} = 6 \times 10^{-4}\ \mathrm{s\,cm^{-1}}$
$\lambda_m = \frac{K \times 1000}{C}$ ...(2)
Put (2) into (1)
$10^{-5} = C \times \frac{K \times 1000}{\lambda_m^{\infty} \times C}$
$\lambda_m^{\infty} = 60 \times 10^{3}\ \mathrm{s\,cm^{2}\,mol^{-1}}$
$= 6\ \mathrm{s\,m^{2}\,mol^{-1}}$
